description: Build, extend, or improve the in-app XLSX report exporters behind the GaaS "Relatório" tab (calendar-estrategico React/TS app). Covers adding a new export button + workbook, adding a new sheet/section to an existing report, adding MoM (month-over-month) comparison, and reusing the shared ExcelJS report helpers. Use this whenever the user asks to create/expand/melhorar a planilha or relatório exportável, add a new report view/aba/sheet, add MoM/comparison columns, wire a new "Exportar XLSX" button in RelatorioView, or work with crmAquisicaoMonthlyReportExport / midiaPagaMonthlyReportExport / aquisicaoCrmExcelExport / rentabilizacaoCrmExcelExport. Trigger even when the user only says "expandir os xlsx do relatório", "outra visão da planilha", or names a Supabase table (activities, paid_media_metrics, b2c_daily_metrics) as a report source.
